title: Adjustment and refund
bodyText:
. The commissioner may:

(1) Adjust any rate to reflect any excess premiums charged during any premium year, or in any subsequent premium year; and

(2) Order a refund to any class.
bodyHtml:
§431:10C-412  Adjustment and refund.  The commissioner may:

     (1)  Adjust any rate to reflect any excess premiums charged during any premium year, or in any subsequent premium year; and

     (2)  Order a refund to any class. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
